name: io.github.hookdeck/mcp-events-bridge
title: MCP Events bridge
description: Turn webhooks into MCP Events that AI agents subscribe to, with Hookdeck Event Gateway.

packageArguments.description: Runs the MCP server. Run `npx mcp-events-bridge setup` once first, in a directory with a bridge.config.ts.

environmentVariables.name: HOOKDECK_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key of the Hookdeck project the bridge uses (project settings, Secrets).

environmentVariables.name: HOOKDECK_SIGNING_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Signing secret of the same Hookdeck project. Verifies Event Gateway's notifications to the bridge.

environmentVariables.name: BRIDGE_MCP_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: The MCP endpoint's secret. `setup` generates one on its first run.

environmentVariables.name: RESEND_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: For the Resend source (inbound email). Needs permission to create webhooks.

environmentVariables.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: For the GitHub source in automatic mode. Fine-grained token with Webhooks (read and write). Only `setup` uses it.
